description: Imagine a call arriving at Concrete's Customer Service Center.
but the caller is following up on an exchange request made last week.
The information exists in Zoho Desk.
The challenge is getting it to the right employee.
Today, as described in Concrete's current workflow, the agent may have to copy the phone number,
Open the customer's previous tickets and then look for the most recent update.
but every extra step interrupts the conversation.
Now imagine a more connected experience.
When an inbound call arrives in Genesys,
the caller number starts an authorized customer lookup.
if it finds one reliable match,
A screen pop opens the relevant customer context.
The customer is asking about an exchange.
The agent can see an earlier ticket and a note saying the request is still pending branch review.
not a promise that the review has happened.
Instead of making the customer explain everything again,
The agent can continue from the last documented point.
If several contacts share a number,
the employee chooses the correct record.
a safe manual search remains available.
and if the lookup service fails,
A phone number alone never proves someone's identity.
We're not replacing Genesys or Zoho Desk.
and we're not pretending a new integration is already live.
we're proposing a clearer way to connect systems that Concrete already uses.
and more attention on the customer.
Those benefits must be measured in a real pilot.
First, we'll review Concrete's existing Genesys pop-up configuration.
Then, we'll test the experience with authorized sample calls and validate the results.
This is the Genesys and Zoho Desk experience proposed by GRINDCTRL for Concrete.
